aliases: The store-level `aliases` object is hand-maintained and preserved by collectors (they rewrite only their own channel section); planning consumes it to merge cross-channel spellings.
description: Channel-declared facts scraped from the Command Code GOAT plan page (three HTML tables) into the commandcode-goat section of the shared models_extra store. The section keys are the entitlement facts of the commandcode channel.

channels.commandcode-goat.<id>.note: id comes from the /models/<slug> anchor (dotted version restored, e.g. qwen3-8-27b -> qwen3.8-27b). Channel-provided claude-* models are not collected (ADR 0012). Speed-marketing variants (-fast/-highspeed) are collected but stamped exclude=speed-variant so planning skips them. No card fields are stored here: the plan fills cards from data/all_models.json, so GOAT-exclusive ids plan with an empty card.

name.consumer: plan name fallback when all_models.json has no card for the id

exclude.consumer: planning skips the record and reports collector_excluded

usage_quota.note: Monthly credits stored under the remark-consumed name usage_quota

cost.source_columns: Input / Output / Cache Read / Cache Write
cost.type: object {input, output, cache_read, cache_write} of float|null
cost.note: GOAT deal pricing; differs from any upstream cost in all_models.json. Discounted cells quote the struck 'was' price (in <s>) before the bare deal price; the deal price is stored.

not_collected.note: Intelligence column drives which models are kept (scored / inherited / default-50) but is not stored: no downstream consumer. Likewise the derived note.

gates: The section keys are the authoritative entitlement facts of the commandcode channel, so any of these fails the run with no write: a main-table row skipped for missing columns; a to_model_id collision; zero models resolved; model count outside expected_count.
write_rule: Read-modify-write via watch-pipeline/scripts/models_extra.py: only channels.commandcode-goat is rewritten. Writers must serialize (CI orders this job after the go job).
